ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high contrast ratio limited to high-intensity (tan/white) pixels located exclusively at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across the visible central and proximal surface area. High-contrast contiguous geometric blobs are present at the extreme left and right terminal coordinates (distal tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex, clearly bisecting the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities (serrations) observed continuously along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, characterized by small jagged pixel peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex upward sweep starting from the median notch and terminating at the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast tan and white pixel groups located at both the left and right distal terminals of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn-shaped calcified encrustations concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.
